items.title: Best pre-trained vision model for multi-plant disease detection in async web back-end
items.summary:
I'm building a web app with FastAPI + async/await Python backend. Users upload leaf photos via API and the server should return: 1) plant species, 2) disease label or "healthy".

Constraints:

  1. Generalization: Must handle multiple crops. Users can upload "any" plant leaf, not just tomato/corn. Target 15+ species.

  2. Server inference: Runs on GPU server, not mobile. Latency 1-2s is acceptable, so model size isn't a bottleneck.

items.title: Mixed-case HTTPS URLs skip the pinned client TLS context
items.summary:
<!-- swarm-issue-worker:adversarial-finding:issue:246;id:0b28b7a59e998aebfa3e -->
Found while testing #246; outside that delivery's scope.

Reproduction: a candidate of HTTPS://host (scheme stored as HTTPS) is kept by _peer_address_candidates because it lowercases, then _drone_client_ssl_context / _peer_get_json use url.startswith('https://') without casefold and return no pin context.
